_: Items whose Forever version Blizzard has shown, applied by scripts/data/lib/items-forever.mjs on top of Classic's data. Each entry names where Blizzard showed it. replace swaps a Classic line for Forever's; add and remove add or drop lines; st, q and r replace the base stats, quality and level requirement.

items.name: Edgemaster's Handguards
items.note: Blizzard showed these at BlizzCon as its example of the weapon skill cut: +1 instead of +7.

source.name: WoW Forever Deep Dive slide, BlizzCon 2026 (via Warcraft Tavern)

items.name: Hide of the Wild
items.note: Blizzard showed it at BlizzCon with 42 bonus healing and 14 bonus damage, the healing rule at work.

source.name: WoW Forever Deep Dive, BlizzCon 2026 (via Icy Veins)

items.name: Wolfshead Helm
replace: Equip: When shapeshifting into Cat form the Druid gains 20 energy, when shapeshifting into Bear form the Druid gains 5 rage.
Equip: Gives you 5 additional Energy when you use Shifting Power.
items.note: Blizzard’s development notes of October 8 changed its effect: 5 more Energy when you use Shifting Power, in place of Energy and Rage when you shapeshift.

source.name: Blizzard, WoW Forever beta development notes, October 8

items.name: Ceremonial Centaur Blanket
items.note: Blizzard’s development notes of October 8 put this Desolace quest reward at level 35 and adjusted its stats to that level; the new stats aren’t published, so Classic’s are shown.

source.name: Blizzard, WoW Forever beta development notes, October 8

items.name: Gloves of Holy Might
items.note: Forever’s version has an effect Classic’s did not: since Blizzard’s hotfixes of 13 November it activates only from harmful spells and abilities that deal damage, after a fix on 9 November. Blizzard has not published its full text, so Classic’s lines are shown.

source.name: Blizzard, WoW: Forever hotfixes (9 and 13 November 2026)
